messages.subject: Calverton v Ferncliffe Alloys - disclosure deadline
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Unrelated to the financing, but flagging on the Calverton v Ferncliffe Alloys matter: the court has set the disclosure deadline for 5 June and Ferncliffe's solicitors (Hargrove) are pushing for an extended list. Patricia is across it but I wanted you to have visibility given the same client. Happy to discuss.

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Litigation | Whitfield Carter LLP
